name: normalDoubleHurt
description: Calculates combo (double hit) damage for players, pals, and cannons

parameters.usePierceResist: boolean, default true — whether to apply pierce/block

formula_steps.formula: ATK = attacker.att, DEF = defender.def, DEF_COE = defender.def_coe

formula_steps.description: Calculate base damage with defense coefficient
Get combo resistance (pierce/block applied for Player and Gun, suppress/inspire for Pal)

Player.formula: dmg = roundInt(baseDmg * combo_multiplier) * round(1 - resistance), dmg = roundInt(dmg)

Partner (Pal).formula: x = roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * pal_multiplier) * round(1 - resistance), dmg = roundInt(roundInt(x) * double_hit_dam), dmg = roundInt(dmg)
Partner (Pal).note: Pal combo first applies pal multiplier and pal resistance, then scales by double_hit_dam

Gun (Cannon).formula: y = roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * partner_dam) * round(1 - season_cannon_att_def), dmg = roundInt(roundInt(y) * double_hit_dam) * round(1 - combo_resistance), dmg = roundInt(dmg)
Gun (Cannon).note: Gun combo applies cannon resistance first, then scales by double_hit_dam with pierce/block on double_hit_def

formula_steps.formula: if (crit_flag != 1): dmg = roundInt(dmg * max(1.5, round(crit_dam / crit_def)))

simplified_formula.player: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * double_hit_dam) * round(1 - pierce_block(double_hit_def))), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
simplified_formula.pal: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(roundInt(roundInt(max(roundInt(parentATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * round(partner_dam * partner_dam_extra)) * round(1 - suppress_inspire(partner_resist))) * double_hit_dam), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
simplified_formula.gun: max(1, calHurt(roundInt(roundInt(roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF*(1+DEF_COE)), 1) * partner_dam) * round(1 - season_cannon_att_def)) * double_hit_dam) * round(1 - pierce_block(double_hit_def)), defender, attacker) * crit_multiplier)
